chunks: Does every one of them wish to enter the garden of tranquility?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran asks if everyone will enter Paradise?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah al-Ma'arij, this verse critiques the presumption of entitlement to Paradise among the disbelievers or specific groups, challenging their assumption that mere association or general inclusion guarantees salvation. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a reminder that divine mercy is coupled with accountability, and entry into the 'Garden of Delight' requires genuine faith and righteous deeds rather than passive expectation.
